# correction. Driver 610.57.04, checkout e4a5faa.

# Request numbers are literal here because the syzkaller tree carrying
# syz-extract is absent from this repository, so a .const file could not be
# produced against a format this tool can check. nvidia_gspwn.h holds
# the same numbers as _IOWR macros for syz-extract to consume on the SUT.

# The re-entrant NV_ESC_IOCTL_XFER_CMD path. nv.c:2499 unwraps the
# wrapper once and re-enters the same dispatch switch with the three
# fields of nv_ioctl_xfer_t, so each variant pins the inner command
# to one escape number, sets the size to that escape's measured
# argument size and points the inner pointer at its parameter
# struct. The two multiplexers are absent: a wrapper naming either
# would leave its inner command or class field free.

# Object allocation. hClass is pinned per class, hObjectParent takes
# the legal parent's handle, and hObjectNew produces the class's own
# resource, which chains one allocation to the next. A class whose
# legal parents all coexist on one chip carries one call per parent,
# named <class>_UNDER_<parent> after the first. A class whose parent
# set is chip-gated carries one call taking nv_handle, because at
# most one of those parents exists on any given GPU.
ioctl$NV_ESC_RM_ALLOC_ACCESS_COUNTER_NOTIFY_BUFFER(fd fd_nv, cmd const[0xc030462b], arg ptr[inout, nvos64_alloc_access_counter_notify_buffer])
ioctl$NV_ESC_RM_ALLOC_ADA_A(fd fd_nv, cmd const[0xc030462b], arg ptr[inout, nvos64_alloc_ada_a])
ioctl$NV_ESC_RM_ALLOC_ADA_COMPUTE_A(fd fd_nv, cmd const[0xc030462b], arg ptr[inout, nvos64_alloc_ada_compute_a])
ioctl$NV_ESC_RM_ALLOC_AMPERE_A(fd fd_nv, cmd const[0xc030462b], arg ptr[inout, nvos64_alloc_ampere_a])
ioctl$NV_ESC_RM_ALLOC_AMPERE_B(fd fd_nv, cmd const[0xc030462b], arg ptr[inout, nvos64_alloc_ampere_b])
ioctl$NV_ESC_RM_ALLOC_AMPERE_CHANNEL_GPFIFO_A(fd fd_nv, cmd const[0xc030462b], arg ptr[inout, nvos64_alloc_ampere_channel_gpfifo_a])
